normalized.result: Yes — that's exactly the behavior I wanted. I searched "CSS Grid" in my normal collection and it came back with nothing, since that one's put away, and then over in the Put away area the CSS Grid bookmark was still sitting there intact. So putting something away really does take it fully out of my way — off the main list and out of my everyday searches — while keeping it safe and findable in its own spot until I restore it. That confirms it for me; this piece is settled.
